label: Figure 20.11: Supply-side policies can reduce the NRU
alt: Two vertical long-run Phillips curves: LRPC1 at the natural rate of unemployment NRU1 and LRPC2 to its left at a lower rate NRU2, with two arrows showing the leftward shift.
caption: Effective supply-side policies, such as better education and training or more flexible labour markets, shift the long-run Phillips curve left from LRPC<sub>1</sub> to LRPC<sub>2</sub>. The natural rate of unemployment falls from NRU<sub>1</sub> to NRU<sub>2</sub> at any given rate of inflation.
